svg.title: SO-101 live control panel and run dashboard
svg.desc: Separates the live control panel, run dashboard, and MuJoCo joint mirror, then plots the measured six-axis joint log.
svg.text: TWO WEB SURFACES / ONE RUN RECORD
The live panel and run dashboard have separate jobs.
Shared joint state; separate control, record, and comparison verdicts.
BOUNDARY Joint sync only · no object-position or grasp-success verdict
